methods.name: Consolidated strategy based on four U-shaped models (UNet and UNet3+)
methods.summary: A consolidated strategy using four deep learning models: (1) UNet using four S2-bands, (2) UNet3+ using four S2-bands, (3) UNet using four S2-bands and VV S1-band, and (4) UNet using four S2-bands and VH S1-band. The models are based on U-shaped architectures (U-Net and U-Net3+) with ResNet34, trained using the Adam optimizer to perform binary semantic segmentation of landslide traces from fused Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 imagery.
methods.verbatim: Therefore, the authors proposed a consolidated strategy based on four models: (1) UNet using four S2-bands, (2) UNet3+ using four S2-bands, (3) UNet using four S2-bands and VV S1-band, and (4) UNet using four S2-bands and VH S1-band for fully detect landslides.
